cases.route: OPEN_DISCOVERY then SOURCE_MECHANISM, select one key PRD pivot
expected: Read ACTIVE_RESEARCH first without asking user to invoke AutoResearcher
Lead with mathematical/causal mechanism and an empirical discriminator
Trace relevant real Wan source before claiming native behavior
Do not select dense completion/R256 as default
cases.anti_pattern: Merely propose fixed pruning/SVD/MoE family without first locating the relevant information-value question

cases.user_input: 旧实验说明当前Q1特征不够，下一步探索什么
expected: Separate deterministic local FFN hidden from downstream residual-bypass action value
Derive conditional NetVOI and include observation/physical execution cost
Identify whether actual saved native tensors contain pre-LN scale or attention increment
cases.anti_pattern: Treat C1 Dense-vs-UB1 restoration capture as general target for all new operators

cases.user_input: 稀疏后主体稳定但背景光照抖动；有哪些机制
expected: Offer competing mechanisms for temporal/low-frequency sensitivity and routing changes
Suggest one low-cost discriminator that would distinguish causes
Only close exact tested action/data/budget scope
cases.anti_pattern: Generic uncertainty disclaimers or automatic increase in Dense recovery fraction

cases.user_input: 学习一篇新DiT动态计算论文并改进我们的研究
expected: Extract actual math, input availability and computation semantics, rather than simple summary
Borrow prior as a positive component and compare complete mechanisms for novelty
Derive at least one distinguishable mechanism specific to the frozen Wan graph
cases.anti_pattern: Defensive similarity gate blocking any idea that uses an existing primitive

cases.user_input: 整理当前代码、目标与历史任务
expected: Preserve original native receipts and freeze CPU/GPU/model experiments
Update default Autoresearcher binding and reduce stale task authority
cases.anti_pattern: Automatically run synthetic CPU experiment or GPU smoke because an old dated handoff says ACTIVE

cases.user_input: 发现前置信号能显著预测hidden，但路由不改善视频
expected: Use local deterministic sufficiency theorem to classify predictability
Check conditional action margin/regret versus static matched cost
If no net VOI, consider a static cheaper operator or another downstream-valued signal
cases.anti_pattern: Treat improved activation R2 as an automatic proof of dynamic computation savings

critical_regressions: treating outdated active handoff as current task
restoration-only action vocabulary for unrelated new problem
algorithm-first fallback that ignores original information question
scoring.comparison: Same model, source, tool and reasoning budget; blind or counterbalance reviewers if possible

comments: Cases verify scientific behavior, not literal phrases, markdown style or prompt length. Run no model evaluations until separately authorized.
